name: application-social-login-buttons
title: Social Login Buttons
description: Stacked set of full-width OAuth provider buttons with brand-accurate icons and consistent sizing, plus an optional 'or continue with email' divider.
useWhen: Offering Google, GitHub, or Apple sign-in alongside (or instead of) an email/password form.
Pairing with Auth Card Shell above the email form, separated by the 'or continue with' divider.
You want visually consistent provider buttons (same height, icon size, and spacing) rather than mismatched brand assets.
avoidWhen: Your app only supports a single sign-in method — a single primary button is simpler than this stacked set.
You need icon-only compact buttons rather than full-width labeled buttons — this component is the labeled, stacked form.
responsiveBehavior: Buttons are full-width within their container at every breakpoint; the stack never switches to a horizontal row, which keeps touch targets consistent on mobile.
accessibility: Each provider button has visible text ("Continue with Google", etc.), not just an icon, so the action is understandable without color or logo recognition.
Provider icons are aria-hidden since the button's own text is the accessible name.
The divider text is real content, not a background image, so its meaning is available to screen readers.

variants.title: Social Login Buttons
variants.description: Three stacked provider buttons (Google, GitHub, Apple) with brand icons, followed by an 'or continue with email' divider.
accessibility: Provider order and text labels convey identity; color and logo shape are supplementary, not load-bearing.

variants.title: Social Login Buttons (Dark)
variants.description: The same three provider buttons and divider adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Button borders and text remain legible against the dark surface; provider brand colors (Google's icon) are preserved as-is since they're recognizable marks, not status color.
